scope: Every distinct building/room pair in the supplied term snapshot, including buildings with no indoor file; sections, additional meetings and exams are parsed by the production parser. This is independent of the old stored-layout-key denominator.

snapshot.sourceDescription: The same public uxdy classroom schedule snapshot consumed by src/lib/TermCache.ts. Upstream scrape time is decoded by coursesFromFile from the snapshot header; downloadedAt is the separate local acquisition time.

methodology.indoorMatching: indexIndoorBuilding; exact scheduleKey and explicit scheduleAliases only
methodology.countUnit: Unique (building, room key) pair, not section count, seat count or distinct physical polygon. Multiple exact schedule aliases can refer to one physical room.

categories.placed: An explicit runtime scheduleKey or alias resolves to a validated room polygon.
categories.floorListed: An unplaced record explicitly cites a source floor listing.
categories.floorInferred: An existing unplaced record infers the floor from the room number.
categories.unmapped: A registered indoor layout has neither an explicit polygon mapping nor an unplaced floor listing for the key, or fails runtime loading checks (errors are reported per building).
categories.no-layout: The building has no registered indoor JSON. An exterior shell or room-number floor hint is not counted as an indoor plan.
categories.nonphysical: Remote RCLAS pairs or an explicitly missing building/room key; excluded from the physical-room denominator. Null TBA locations are reported as records separately because they supply no unique room key.

methodology.runtimeScheduleSubset: Separately counted using the unchanged site's aggregator, which excludes null locations, RCLAS, missing time and empty day lists.
methodology.candidatePolicy: Exact printed-label matches are reported for review; no leading-zero, punctuation, building-alias or room-identity guesses are counted as placed.
limitations: This reflects the snapshot's upstream scrape time, not a fresh UCSD registrar scrape at audit execution.
Room outlines may retain historical-source and geometric uncertainties documented in their layouts. Placed is a mapping category, not a surveyed-accuracy guarantee.
A missing time does not erase a named physical classroom from the full snapshot audit; use runtimeScheduleSummary for the visible classroom schedule subset.

nonphysical.note: Null location means TBA/unspecified, not proof of online delivery. These records cannot define distinct room keys and are excluded from both physical and keyed coverage counts.

keys.reason: Current schedule key; the normal public first-floor viewer returned an error. No room polygon or floor outline was recovered.
